nodes.name: StructuralRelation
nodes.definition: A relation specifying classification, identity or composition structure.

nodes.name: SemanticRelation
nodes.definition: A relation specifying meaning, reference or representation without asserting empirical causation.

nodes.name: ParticipationRelation
nodes.definition: A relation connecting an unfolding process with a participant, input, output or instrument.

nodes.name: TemporalRelation
nodes.definition: A relation constraining the temporal positions or extents of occurrences.

nodes.name: CausalRelation
nodes.definition: A relation asserting a causal contribution or enabling condition under a specified context.

nodes.name: EpistemicRelation
nodes.definition: A relation connecting claims, observations, evidence or reasoning dependencies.

nodes.name: ComputationalRelation
nodes.definition: A relation concerning specifications, software artifacts, computations or computational resources.

nodes.name: SocialRelation
nodes.definition: A relation concerning agents, institutions, obligations or contextual social roles.

nodes.name: QuantitativeRelation
nodes.definition: A relation assigning or comparing quantities under specified properties, units and conditions.

nodes.name: SubjectRole
nodes.definition: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

nodes.name: ObjectRole
nodes.definition: The entity to which the asserted contextual relationship is directed.

nodes.name: SubtypeRole
nodes.definition: The narrower class in a universal inclusion statement.

nodes.name: SupertypeRole
nodes.definition: The broader class in a universal inclusion statement.

nodes.name: IdentityRole
nodes.definition: The continuing identity represented or classified, distinct from its temporary state.

nodes.name: TypeRole
nodes.definition: The class specifying what an identity is, rather than a temporary role it plays.

nodes.name: StateRole
nodes.definition: The temporally scoped state of an identified entity.

nodes.name: PartRole
nodes.definition: A constituent in a composition claim; not a subtype merely by being a constituent.

nodes.name: WholeRole
nodes.definition: The containing entity in a composition claim.

nodes.name: PropertyRole
nodes.definition: The attribute or criterion under which a value or classification is asserted.

nodes.name: ValueRole
nodes.definition: The measured, estimated or otherwise qualified property value.

nodes.name: UnitRole
nodes.definition: The scale convention required to interpret a numerical value.

nodes.name: ProgramRole
nodes.definition: An executable or predictive mechanism bound to a process under an explicit execution role.

nodes.name: ProcessRole
nodes.definition: The unfolding activity whose participants, implementation or dependencies are described.

nodes.name: DependentRole
nodes.definition: The claim or artifact whose interpretation or validity depends on the source.

nodes.name: SourceRole
nodes.definition: The supporting information, artifact or origin upon which another item depends.

nodes.name: AgentRole
nodes.definition: The actor participating in or responsible for a contextual activity.

nodes.name: InputRole
nodes.definition: A resource or information item consumed or consulted by a process.

nodes.name: OutputRole
nodes.definition: A resource or information item produced by a process.

nodes.name: InstrumentRole
nodes.definition: A tool used to perform a process, distinct from the process and its product.

nodes.name: EarlierRole
nodes.definition: The occurrence constrained to precede the other occurrence.

nodes.name: LaterRole
nodes.definition: The occurrence constrained to follow the other occurrence.

nodes.name: CauseRole
nodes.definition: A causally relevant occurrence under the stated mechanism and conditions.

nodes.name: EffectRole
nodes.definition: An occurrence causally affected under the stated mechanism and conditions.

nodes.name: ClaimRole
nodes.definition: The proposition whose epistemic status is being discussed.

nodes.name: EvidenceRole
nodes.definition: The observation or information used in a qualified evidential assessment.

nodes.name: ContextRole
nodes.definition: The scope or conditions under which the asserted relation applies.

nodes.name: ContextualRoleRole
nodes.definition: The temporary capacity played by an entity within a stated context.

nodes.name: SpecificationRole
nodes.definition: The description of required behavior or structure being implemented or checked.

nodes.name: SUBTYPE_OF
nodes.definition: Every member of type is a member of supertype by definition. One immediate parent is selected; this does not imply disjoint siblings, typical properties, parts, roles or topic membership.
counterexamples: Compiler is not a subtype of Compilation; it participates in compilation.

signature.label: type
signature.description: The narrower class in a universal inclusion statement.

signature.label: supertype
signature.description: The broader class in a universal inclusion statement.

nodes.name: IDENTITY_TYPE
nodes.definition: An identity has exactly one primary defining class. Secondary roles and changing states are separate assertions.

signature.label: instance
signature.description: The continuing identity represented or classified, distinct from its temporary state.

signature.label: type
signature.description: The class specifying what an identity is, rather than a temporary role it plays.

nodes.name: STATE_IDENTITY
nodes.definition: A temporal facet describes one continuing identity and is not a new independent identity.

signature.label: facet
signature.description: The temporally scoped state of an identified entity.

signature.label: instance
signature.description: The continuing identity represented or classified, distinct from its temporary state.

nodes.name: PART_WHOLE
nodes.definition: Part is a constituent of whole in the asserted composition sense; composition does not entail taxonomic inclusion.

signature.label: part
signature.description: A constituent in a composition claim; not a subtype merely by being a constituent.

signature.label: whole
signature.description: The containing entity in a composition claim.

nodes.name: HAS_NUMERIC_VALUE
nodes.definition: Entity has the stated numeric property value under the fact conditions and optional unit; missing assessment is not certainty.

signature.label: entity
signature.description: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

signature.label: property
signature.description: The attribute or criterion under which a value or classification is asserted.

signature.label: value
signature.description: The measured, estimated or otherwise qualified property value.

signature.label: unit
signature.description: The scale convention required to interpret a numerical value.

nodes.name: CLASSIFIED_AS
nodes.definition: Entity satisfies the stated classification criterion in context. This need not be its primary identity type and grants no second taxonomic parent.

signature.label: entity
signature.description: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

signature.label: class
signature.description: The class specifying what an identity is, rather than a temporary role it plays.

nodes.name: PROGRAM_FOR_PROCESS
nodes.definition: Program has an explicitly declared exec or model binding for the process; a predictive model does not execute the process merely by being bound.
counterexamples: A model Program forecasts a process; this does not assert it performs the process.

signature.label: program
signature.description: An executable or predictive mechanism bound to a process under an explicit execution role.

signature.label: process
signature.description: The unfolding activity whose participants, implementation or dependencies are described.

nodes.name: EVIDENCE_DEPENDS_ON
nodes.definition: Assessment of dependent relies on source information; invalidating the source requires review of dependent assessments. It is neither temporal precedence nor physical causation.
examples: A conclusion depends on a measurement report.
counterexamples: A report does not physically cause the event it reports.

signature.label: dependent
signature.description: The claim or artifact whose interpretation or validity depends on the source.

signature.label: source
signature.description: The supporting information, artifact or origin upon which another item depends.

nodes.name: RELATION_SUBJECT
nodes.definition: The source predicate concerns target as a subject of its definition. This indexing link grants no inheritance and does not assert a relation instance.

signature.label: source
signature.description: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

signature.label: target
signature.description: The entity to which the asserted contextual relationship is directed.

nodes.name: ABOUT
nodes.definition: Source refers to target as a topic or subject. This is an explicit semantic reference, not identity, subtype, evidence or causation.

signature.label: source
signature.description: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

signature.label: target
signature.description: The entity to which the asserted contextual relationship is directed.

nodes.name: REPRESENTS
nodes.definition: Source encodes or depicts target under the stated representation convention; the representation is not identical to its referent.

signature.label: source
signature.description: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

signature.label: target
signature.description: The entity to which the asserted contextual relationship is directed.

nodes.name: HAS_PARTICIPANT
nodes.definition: Entity participates in a process without asserting a more specific agent, input or instrument role.

signature.label: process
signature.description: The unfolding activity whose participants, implementation or dependencies are described.

signature.label: participant
signature.description: The entity to which the asserted contextual relationship is directed.

nodes.name: PERFORMED_BY
nodes.definition: An agent intentionally performs the process in the stated episode or general specification.

signature.label: process
signature.description: The unfolding activity whose participants, implementation or dependencies are described.

signature.label: agent
signature.description: The actor participating in or responsible for a contextual activity.

nodes.name: USES_INPUT
nodes.definition: A process consumes or consults input; use alone does not establish correctness or causal sufficiency.

signature.label: process
signature.description: The unfolding activity whose participants, implementation or dependencies are described.

signature.label: input
signature.description: A resource or information item consumed or consulted by a process.

nodes.name: PRODUCES
nodes.definition: A process produces an output, distinct from its procedure, executing tool and success assessment.

signature.label: process
signature.description: The unfolding activity whose participants, implementation or dependencies are described.

signature.label: output
signature.description: A resource or information item produced by a process.

nodes.name: USES_INSTRUMENT
nodes.definition: A process employs an instrument to carry out its activity.

signature.label: process
signature.description: The unfolding activity whose participants, implementation or dependencies are described.

signature.label: instrument
signature.description: A tool used to perform a process, distinct from the process and its product.

nodes.name: PRECEDES
nodes.definition: Earlier finishes before later begins in the stated temporal frame; this says nothing about cause or evidence.
counterexamples: Temporal order alone does not imply causation.

signature.label: earlier
signature.description: The occurrence constrained to precede the other occurrence.

signature.label: later
signature.description: The occurrence constrained to follow the other occurrence.

nodes.name: IMMEDIATELY_PRECEDES
nodes.definition: Earlier precedes later with no intervening occurrence in the explicitly specified sequence; sequence scope is required in fact conditions.

signature.label: previous
signature.description: The occurrence constrained to precede the other occurrence.

signature.label: next
signature.description: The occurrence constrained to follow the other occurrence.

specialization.entailment: Absence of intervening occurrences strengthens, and never removes, the temporal precedence assertion. Preserve sequence and time qualifiers.

nodes.name: TEMPORALLY_OVERLAPS
nodes.definition: Two process extents share time in the stated frame, without requiring shared participants or causation.

signature.label: first
signature.description: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

signature.label: second
signature.description: The entity to which the asserted contextual relationship is directed.

nodes.name: CAUSES
nodes.definition: Cause contributes causally to effect under the specified mechanism and conditions; correlation or earlier occurrence alone is insufficient.
examples: A particular heating process causes expansion under stated material conditions.
counterexamples: A diagnostic observation need not cause the observed fault.

signature.label: cause
signature.description: A causally relevant occurrence under the stated mechanism and conditions.

signature.label: effect
signature.description: An occurrence causally affected under the stated mechanism and conditions.

nodes.name: ENABLES
nodes.definition: Source makes target process possible under context without asserting that target actually occurs or that source is sufficient.

signature.label: source
signature.description: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

signature.label: target
signature.description: The unfolding activity whose participants, implementation or dependencies are described.

nodes.name: SUPPORTS_CLAIM
nodes.definition: Evidence favors a claim under an explicit observation model and context; strength is assessed separately and shared origins are not independent repetitions.

signature.label: evidence
signature.description: The observation or information used in a qualified evidential assessment.

signature.label: claim
signature.description: The proposition whose epistemic status is being discussed.

nodes.name: CHALLENGES_CLAIM
nodes.definition: Evidence weighs against a claim under a stated interpretation; this does not by itself establish the negation.

signature.label: evidence
signature.description: The observation or information used in a qualified evidential assessment.

signature.label: claim
signature.description: The proposition whose epistemic status is being discussed.

nodes.name: DERIVED_FROM
nodes.definition: A representation or conclusion was produced from source material; provenance does not automatically confer truth or independent support.

signature.label: dependent
signature.description: The claim or artifact whose interpretation or validity depends on the source.

signature.label: source
signature.description: The supporting information, artifact or origin upon which another item depends.

nodes.name: CONTRADICTS
nodes.definition: Two propositions cannot both hold under the same meanings, time, jurisdiction and other conditions. Context mismatch alone is not contradiction.

signature.label: first
signature.description: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

signature.label: second
signature.description: The entity to which the asserted contextual relationship is directed.

nodes.name: IMPLEMENTS
nodes.definition: A concrete artifact realizes a specification or algorithm under a stated implementation interpretation. An execution run is separate.

signature.label: artifact
signature.description: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

signature.label: specification
signature.description: The description of required behavior or structure being implemented or checked.

nodes.name: EXECUTES
nodes.definition: A computational process runs a specified software artifact; source text, tool and execution episode remain distinct.

signature.label: process
signature.description: The unfolding activity whose participants, implementation or dependencies are described.

signature.label: program
signature.description: An executable or predictive mechanism bound to a process under an explicit execution role.

nodes.name: ARTIFACT_DEPENDS_ON
nodes.definition: An artifact requires another artifact for the specified build, execution or deployment context. This is not evidence dependence.

signature.label: dependent
signature.description: The claim or artifact whose interpretation or validity depends on the source.

signature.label: source
signature.description: The supporting information, artifact or origin upon which another item depends.

nodes.name: SATISFIES_SPECIFICATION
nodes.definition: Artifact satisfies the stated specification within an explicit checked scope; a passing example alone does not imply universal correctness.

signature.label: artifact
signature.description: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

signature.label: specification
signature.description: The description of required behavior or structure being implemented or checked.

nodes.name: PLAYS_ROLE
nodes.definition: An entity plays a temporary or contextual role within an explicit context. The role is not its identity type or a new taxonomic parent.

signature.label: entity
signature.description: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

signature.label: role
signature.description: The temporary capacity played by an entity within a stated context.

signature.label: context
signature.description: The scope or conditions under which the asserted relation applies.

nodes.name: LOCATED_AT
nodes.definition: An entity occupies a location during the stated interval and spatial frame. A location is neither a subtype nor a part by this assertion alone.

signature.label: entity
signature.description: The entity whose contextual relationship is being asserted.

signature.label: location
signature.description: The entity to which the asserted contextual relationship is directed.

nodes.name: TRAINING_USES_DATA
nodes.definition: A learning process uses an information item as training input; evaluation-only use does not meet this predicate.

signature.label: training
signature.description: The unfolding activity whose participants, implementation or dependencies are described.

signature.label: data
signature.description: A resource or information item consumed or consulted by a process.

specialization.entailment: Training input use entails process input use with the same provenance and qualifications; it does not imply an independent second fact.
